leadText:
A Tourist (Japanese: ツアーきゃく Tourist) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VI. They are depicted as people from other regions traveling to and staying in Kalos for leisure. As they represent the large number of Japanese tourists that visit France, most of them have Japanese names. A male Tourist and a young female Tourist are called .

They are very similar to the , who took their place in .

They use any Pokémon not introduced in Generations V or VI (due to them not being based on regions in Japan while Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh were)

===Pokémon the Series===
====Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction====
An adult female Tourist made a cameo appearance in the Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction. A young female tourist was also briefly seen during the movie's ending credits.

===Pokémon Generations===
An adult female Tourist briefly appeared in a flashback in The Investigation.

===Pokémon Adventures===
In Sylveon Enchants, an adult female Tourist appeared in the Mini-game Corner with her .
